pieces.name: main
pieces.notes: long hip body, ridge NE-SW from about (330,620) to (450,520), hipped both ends; NW face is the big 725 sq ft 7/12 plane

pieces.name: east_wing
pieces.notes: narrower NE extension continuing the main ridge direction, hipped at the NE end, lower than the main

pieces.name: se_cross
pieces.notes: cross wing on the SE side, ridge NW-SE (perpendicular to main), hips meet near (470,590), hipped at its SE end next to the patio inner corner

pieces.name: sw_wing
pieces.notes: SW block, ridge parallel to main, hipped at the S corner; overlaps the main at its NE end; small front bump near (420,730) is inside it

exclude_notes: dark ground at the W corner notch, trace overshoots
ground SE of the house: parked car and trees
white concrete patio inside the inner corner
notes: House rotated 45 deg, 1-story. v1 had three parallel hips; the SE cross wing (ridge perpendicular to main) was missing and the sw_wing reached into the trees, now shortened. Confidence medium.
